verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Feature Flags API for assigning users to variants for experiments/rollouts and a marketing statement about 'designing, running, and analyzing tests and rollouts' alongside analytics, implying built-in A/B testing capability, but no evidence describes goal-metric configuration or statistical-significance reporting mechanics. Missing for 10: documentation of goal metric setup, statistical significance/confidence calculations, experiment results UI, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the experimentation feature.
